author: Ribeiro, Horch, Terossi & Mantelatto, 2024

note.en: A tiny parasitic isopod described in 2024 from a single female found on the pleon (tail) of a Hippolyte shrimp at Cahuita; it is only a record.
note.es: Un isópodo parásito diminuto descrito en 2024 a partir de una sola hembra hallada en el pleón (cola) de un camarón Hippolyte en Cahuita; es solo un registro.

evidence: Holotype from Cahuita, collected by I. Wehrtmann (about 2002 to 2003); described in Zootaxa 2024
OBIS: one record, Caribbean Costa Rica

sources.t: WoRMS: Metaphrixus wehrtmanni Ribeiro, Horch, Terossi & Mantelatto, 2024
Ribeiro, Horch, Terossi & Mantelatto 2024, A new species of Metaphrixus (Isopoda: Bopyridae: Hemiarthrinae) associated with a Hippolytidae shrimp from Costa Rica, Zootaxa 5501(3): 458-466
